basic_info.description: Lovingly preserved Mid-Century Mediterranean Revival w/ Spanish & Art Deco influences in SF's coveted Westwood Park! 200 Colon Ave is a charming 2BD/1BA home w/ generous flrpln, stunning period details & large garage w/ possible expansion potential, all in the heart of Westwood Park near Ocean Ave, West Portal, Stonestown & EZ commute/transit access. A formal foyer opens to a gorgeous LR w/ original wood trim, coved ceilings, bay windows & decorative FP w/built-ins. Spacious formal DR w/custom sideboard fits a large table - ideal for gatherings. Central KIT offers ample cabinetry, granite counters, dbl oven & skylight. Light-filled breakfast nook w/ vintage built-in is perfect for coffee & casual meals. Two rear BDs offer privacy & garden views; primary BD features adjoining sunroom, 2nd BD has office/study built-ins, Romeo balcony & garden access w/ patios & mature landscaping. Updated BA blends original charm & modern updates. Large garage w/laundry, storage & workspace. Paid solar, HW flrs & fresh paint. On a serene block, this well-cared-for home offers easy access to all SF has to offer.
